surface: Complete @mantine/notifications 9.5.0 runtime surface: Notifications, stores, show, hide, update, clean, queueing, auto-close, hover pause, and drag or wheel dismissal.
divergences: Enter and exit state styles are rendered directly by Octane instead of react-transition-group.
Pointer, drag, wheel, and close callbacks receive native browser events.
ssr: Notification containers render deterministic store state; timers and dismissal listeners activate on the client.
